name: scene-vel
title: Vel
description: A magenta bougainvillea grows from behind a laterite compound wall by a seeded L-system, arches up and spills down the lime-washed cap, drawn as inline SVG. Quiet is the grown vine as a still, warm grows it and lets a breeze move a few tips while a bract lets go now and then, playful stirs the branch under the hand and shakes bracts loose. For heroes and seasonal sections over a wall of text.

budget.reason: Two worlds ported line for line from the plate: the L-system vine with its turtle, taper and growth schedule, and the laterite wall with its sky, palms, pits, stains, cap and ground; the SVG renderer then drives every animation from the scene clock.
